title: The Seventh Chess Player
next_chapter_hook: The voice of the ancient will echoed in Chen Ji's mind: 'Our bloodline will end this eternal chess game.' At this moment, Chen Nian, far away at the Holy Sect, suddenly raised her head, gazing toward the Tianqing Sect—she felt something.

text.content: A violent resonance exploded from his chest, as if thousands of needles were piercing every pattern of the Tianji Record simultaneously. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, pressing both hands firmly against his chest. The ancient, fragmented tome was visibly emanating golden light. He saw—within that radiance, a face seven-tenths similar to his own was gazing at him, eyes showing no hostility, only boundless weariness and... anticipation.

dialogue.content: "Who... are you? Why do you resemble me so closely?"

text.content: The face didn't answer immediately, slowly raising a hand to point at Chen Ji's chest—that exact spot where the Tianji Record resonated most intensely with his heart. An ancient voice surged into his mind like a tide, each word carrying ten thousand years of vicissitude: 'My name is Chen Yuan, one of the first generation of chess players who rebelled against the Ultimate Chess Master ten thousand years ago.' Pausing, a complex light flickered in those eyes so similar to Chen Ji's, 'And also... your ancestor.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Ancestor? This word exploded in his mind, completely contradicting all his previous speculations. He had always believed what was sealed within him was some ancient fierce beast or evil spirit, never imagining it would be the source of his own bloodline. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm, his voice hoarse: 'Since you're an ancestor, why be sealed within me? And who... is this Ultimate Chess Master?'

dialogue.content: The Ultimate Chess Master... is what you call the Eye of Heavenly Way. Ten thousand years ago, my six siblings and I discovered its true nature—it was not a fair arbiter, but a manipulator who treated all living beings as chess pieces. We rose up in rebellion; of the seven, six fell. Only I escaped into the Tianji Record with my fragmented soul, clinging to existence until now.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his worldview being completely overturned. He had always believed he was playing a game against some powerful enemy, never expecting this chess game to have already lasted ten thousand years. He closed his eyes, his mind racing: 'Then now... do you intend to reclaim this body?' The question was direct, yet showed no fear. Chen Yuan's fragmented soul remained silent for a moment, and a hint of a smile actually appeared in those eyes.

dialogue.content: Reclaim? If that were my intention, I could have acted ten thousand years ago when your grandfather's seal shattered. Why wait until today? What I need is to find a descendant who can carry my will and inherit my unfinished cause. And you... are the only one in ten thousand years to simultaneously gain the Tianji Record's recognition and possess pure bloodline.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, gazing directly at the face so similar to his own. He never believed in free lunches, much less in kindness without reason. 'If you chose me, there must be a price.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Speak—what do you need me to do?' Chen Yuan's fragmented soul nodded slightly, seemingly quite satisfied with his composure: 'Kill the Eye of Heavenly Way, end this eternal chess game. And in exchange—'

dialogue.content: I will pass on to you everything I learned in my lifetime, including all memories and experiences from when I fought against it. And the seal of the Heavenly Fate Lock within your body... I can help reinforce it, allowing your sister temporary relief from her torment.

text.content: Chen Nian! Hearing this name, Chen Ji's heart clenched tightly. His sister he had been desperately searching for all these years, his close relative taken by the Holy Sect to serve as a Heavenly Fate Lock... Chen Yuan actually knew of her existence? He lifted his head sharply, his voice unconsciously rising by three degrees: 'Can you save Niannian? She's currently under the Holy Sect's control, suffering daily from the backlash of Heavenly Fate!'

choice.prompt: Facing the transaction proposed by his ancestor Chen Yuan, Chen Ji must make a choice. This is a crucial step that will alter his destiny; every choice will determine the relationship between him and the ancient will.

choices.description: Completely fuse with the ancestor's fragmented soul, gaining all memories and power, but possibly losing part of self-awareness.
choices.visible_cost: May lose part of the self
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete inheritance and methods to oppose the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is perilous; failure results in soul destruction

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and placed his hand upon the golden light at his chest. He could sense Chen Yuan's vast, ocean-like fragmented soul awaiting his response, its contained power sufficient to overturn his entire understanding of cultivation. 'Alright.' He spoke only this single word, yet his voice was utterly unwavering. Chen Yuan's fragmented soul emitted a sigh-like laugh: 'Worthy of being a Chen family son.'

Brilliant golden light blazed forth. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being enveloped by a gentle yet irresistible force. He saw—beneath the starlit sky of ten thousand years ago, seven figures stood proudly; he saw the true form of the Eye of Heavenly Way, that supreme eye controlling the fate of all things; and he saw Chen Yuan transforming into a sword, striking toward the heavens...

choices.description: Refuse fusion, forcefully suppress the ancestor's will using the Tianji Record's power, maintaining independent self.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain complete inheritance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain self-awareness, allowing gradual negotiation with the ancestor
choices.risk_hint: The ancestor's will is immensely powerful; failure to suppress will result in backlash

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes instantly turned cold. It wasn't that he didn't trust Chen Yuan, but he understood the nature of such deals all too well—merging meant surrendering control, and he would never hand his fate over to anyone, even if it was his own ancestor. "Senior," he clasped his hands, his tone neither humble nor overbearing, "I thank you for your kindness, but this path... I wish to walk it myself."

choices.description: Establish an equal cooperative relationship with the ancestor, sharing body control and exchanging resources freely.
choices.visible_cost: Requires dividing some energy to communicate with the ancestor
choices.visible_reward: Can maintain the self while also gaining partial inheritance and guidance
choices.risk_hint: Cooperation requires high trust; disagreements may lead to internal friction

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then raised his head, a hint of warmth flickering in his gaze that he himself hadn't noticed. "Senior... no, Ancestor. I dare to propose—why can't we cooperate as equals?" He paused, then continued, "You need an inheritor to complete your unfinished cause, and I need strength to protect those I care about. Instead of merging or suppressing... let's make a fair trade."

Chen Yuan's remnant soul froze momentarily, then burst into hearty laughter—a sound of unrestrained joy unseen in ten thousand years. "Excellent! Excellent! A perfectly balanced trade! Our Chen family truly produces remarkable talents!" The laughter gradually subsided, and a look of relief and emotion appeared in those eyes. "You resemble a true chess player more than I did in my youth—not through brute force, but through wisdom."

At this moment, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—the Tianji Record was trembling violently. He looked down to see a blurry figure emerging from the golden light, bearing resemblance to him yet weathered by countless years. "Child..." The voice was ancient and weary, yet carried the warmth of bloodline connection. "I have waited for this moment... far too long."

Chen Ji rose slowly, the Tianji Record's golden light flowing around him, no longer dazzling but warm like a bloodline's call. He closed his eyes, feeling that unfamiliar yet familiar energy flowing through his body. It was Chen Yuan's ten-thousand-year obsession,不甘, and waiting—all transformed into this moment of resonance with him. He murmured softly: "Ancestor, the chess game you couldn't finish ten thousand years ago... let me end it."

choice.prompt: After establishing contact with the ancestor, Chen Ji can attempt to sense his sister Chen Nian's location. But this process consumes Heavenly Fate Value, and he must make a choice.

choices.description: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate Value, attempt to locate Chen Nian through bloodline resonance.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain accurate location information about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May be noticed by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, pressing both hands against the golden light on his chest. The power of bloodline surged instantly, and he felt himself becoming an invisible thread, piercing through countless formations, reaching across the heavens and earth—then, he sensed it. Deep within the Holy Sect in the extreme north, a familiar aura was struggling in agony. It was Niannian, his sister!

choices.description: Don't rush to find the sister; first accept Chen Yuan's partial inheritance to increase strength.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ancestor's battle experience and cultivation insights

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Finding Niannian was important, but without sufficient strength, rushing there would only mean death. He closed his eyes again and spoke to Chen Yuan's remnant soul: "Ancestor, please grant me strength. I need to grow stronger first, to protect her." Chen Yuan's remnant soul nodded approvingly: "Good, my child truly possesses deep wisdom."

dialogue.content: Meanwhile, deep within the Holy Sect in the extreme north. In a dim stone chamber, a girl in tattered clothes suddenly opened her eyes, tears streaming down her face as she gazed southward. Hanging at her chest was a dim jade pendant inscribed with a simple character "Ji"—carved by her brother himself. "Brother..." Chen Nian whispered weakly, "You've finally... come for me..."

text.content: At the Tianqing Sect far away, Chen Ji's heart suddenly ached sharply, as if sensing something. He下意识地捂住胸口，那里正有一枚同样的玉佩在隐隐发热。He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the sect gates, looking toward the extreme north, murmuring softly: "Niannian, wait for me a little longer. This time, brother will never let you endure it alone again."

Chen Yuan's remnant soul gazed at the unwavering light in his grandson's eyes, falling silent for a long while. When he spoke again, his voice carried a tenderness unseen in ten thousand years: "Child, do you know? When the seven of us rose in rebellion back then, we too had such eyes." After a pause, his voice turned solemn: "Since you've chosen the path of cooperation, this old man shall reveal a secret—the Heavenly God's Eye is not invincible—it has a fatal weakness..."

dialogue.content: Its power stems from the fate force of all living beings in the world. Whenever someone uses the Tianji Record to peer into the future or alter cause and effect, strands of fate force flow into its body. But if one could, undetected by it, sever this force...

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. Sever the fate force? What did that mean? He rapidly processed the information in his mind: every use of the Tianji Record consumed Heavenly Fate Value, and the Heavenly Fate Value... Something suddenly occurred to him, and his expression shifted: "Ancestor, you're saying—the Tianji Record itself is merely a tool for the Heavenly God's Eye to harvest fate force?" Chen Yuan's remnant soul let out a bitter laugh: "Clever. Do you think that fractured Tianji Record survived to this day by accident?"

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji faced a critical choice: continue using the power of the Tianji Record, or seek a way to completely break free from the Heavenly God's Eye's control?

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record serves as the Heavenly God's Eye's eyes and ears, why not turn it around and use it to transmit false information?
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise control over each foresight's causal fluctuation
choices.visible_reward: Can cause the Heavenly God's Eye to receive erroneous fate information
choices.risk_hint: If detected, complete exposure will follow

text.content: A cold smile slowly curved Chen Ji's lips. Since the Heavenly God's Eye viewed them all as mere pieces, he would become the one who shook the board. "Ancestor, since it wants to watch a show, let's perform an excellent play for it." His eyes gleamed with dangerous light: "The future I want it to see... will be entirely false."

choices.description: Request Chen Yuan's assistance to fundamentally transform the Tianji Record and sever its connection to the Heavenly God's Eye.
choices.visible_cost: The transformation process is perilous and may damage the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a Tianji Record completely independent from the Heavenly God's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Failure will result in the complete destruction of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji raised the Tianji Record in his hand, his gaze profound: "No, I will transform this thing into something that belongs solely to me." A flicker of approval crossed Chen Yuan's remnant soul's eyes: "Good! You have courage! But this will require an enormous price— are you willing to bear it?" Chen Ji offered no answer, merely pressing his palm against the Tianji Record's cover, allowing golden blood to seep out...

The golden blood slowly seeped into the Tianji Record's cover, and Chen Ji sensed a subtle shift occurring in his connection with this ancient tome. No longer simply holder and tool, but a deeper level of... fusion. Chen Yuan's voice rang in his mind, carrying both gratification and anticipation: "From this day forth, you are the seventh Chess Player. The Tianji Record shall be completely fused with your bloodline, no longer controlled by the Heavenly God's Eye."

dialogue.content: Chen Yuan's voice echoed in his mind, carrying an excitement unseen in ten thousand years: "Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! Our Chen family has finally produced another Chess Player!" After a pause, his voice turned solemn: "But remember, your mission is not merely revenge or self-preservation— it is to end this ancient chess game, so that all living beings beneath heaven are no longer manipulated by the Heavenly God's Eye's selfish desires."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. He felt unprecedentedly clear, as if a layer of shackles had been completely shattered. His Tianji Record remained in his hand, but the energy flowing within had become entirely different— that was power belonging solely to himself. He raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon, a faint smile curving his lips: "Heavenly God's Eye, the chess game you've orchestrated for ten thousand years... it's time to end." The moment the words fell, the jade pendant at his chest suddenly blazed with intense heat— Nian Nian was responding to him.
